review_candidates.title: Staff Software Engineer - Traffic
review_candidates.description: We’re looking for a Staff Software Engineer to join Procore’s Traffic team within Developer Acceleration . In this role, you’ll serve as a technical leader for our traffic and edge networking ecosystem, driving the design and evolution of the API gateways, CDN, and ingress/egress infrastructure that sit in front of nearly every request Procore serves. Your primary goal is to set the technical direction for critical initiatives—including our migration off legacy API gateway technology to modern, cloud-native alternatives—while mentoring engineers across a globally distributed team. As a Staff Software Engineer, you’ll partner with Engineering Management, Security, and peer Developer Acceleration teams -including Secrets & Observability- to ensure our traffic layer meets the reliability, security, and compliance bar that Procore’s global customer base depends on. Use your deep expertise in API gateways, service mesh, and CDN/edge technologies to deliver resilient, scalable, and elegantly simple traffic infrastructure that serves as the backbone of Procore’s platform. Join us to be a technical pacesetter on a team that keeps the world's construction software running—Apply today! This position reports into the Senior Engineering Manager, Traffic and will be based in our Cairo, Egypt office. We’re looking for someone to join us immediately. What you’ll do: Set the overall technical tone and direction for Traffic initiatives focusing on modern, cloud-native alternatives. Design, implement, and maintain scalable ingress/egress infrastructure, including API gateways, CDN/Edge Compute configurations, mTLS, and DNS. Serve as the subject matter expert within the traffic and edge networking domain, championing best practices across tools, processes, and procedures. Partner with Security and compliance-focused teams to ensure traffic infrastructure meets Security & Compliance Controls and other regulatory requirements. Leverage AI-assisted development tools and agentic workflows to accelerate delivery, automate routine tasks, and improve code quality across the team. Mentor and develop teammates through code reviews, pairing, and training, actively growing a distributed engineering team across time zones. Troubleshoot and resolve complex production issues across services, platforms, and infrastructure, serving as an escalation point during incidents. Build and maintain comprehensive documentation and runbooks to ensure operational knowledge scales with the team. What we’re looking for: Experience: 8+ years of combined experience as a Software, Systems, Infrastructure, or Site Reliability Engineer, with a proven track record of technical leadership. Strong experience in one of the following programming languages (Go, Python, Typescript, Ruby) Technical Expertise: Deep experience with API gateway and service mesh technologies (such as Kong and Envoy Proxy/Gateway) and production experience with CDN and edge platforms at scale. Networking Knowledge: Strong understanding of DNS, ingress/egress networking, and cloud networking fundamentals (VPCs, routing, peering). Tooling & Security: Experience with Infrastructure as Code tooling (Terraform, Helm); familiarity with secrets management and Zero Trust patterns (HashiCorp Vault, OIDC) is a plus. AI Literacy: An AI-First Development Mindset with proficiency leveraging AI tools (Claude, LLM Gateways, and autonomous agents) to accelerate the software development lifecycle. Systems Thinking: A systems thinker who finds enjoyment in the complexities of distributed systems, balanced with a pragmatic commitment to shipping working, high-quality code. Communication & Collaboration: Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to translate ambiguous requirements into clear technical direction and collaborate across time zones. Leadership: Demonstrated experience mentoring engineers and up-leveling the technical discourse of a team.

review_candidates.title: Data Engineer 2
review_candidates.description: Overview The Windows and Devices mission is to build innovative, trusted, and open products and platforms that are centered on people, showcase the best of Microsoft, and empower every person and organization on the planet to achieve more. To achieve this mission, Microsoft Devices designs and manufactures 1st party premium hardware products including Surface, Xbox Gaming, HoloLens and Accessories. From product creation through product delivery, we innovate in technology and processes across our supply and manufacturing base. Within the Windows and Devices (W+D) organization, we are the Microsoft Devices Operations organization. Our mission to enrich work, life, and play by bringing iconic Microsoft products to life, and we accomplish this by managing a highly leveraged, fully digitized supply base that meets our product and business goals. As part of our scope, we manage New Product Introduction, Product Engineering, Strategic Sourcing, Global Manufacturing Operations, Manufacturing Test & Infrastructure (MTI), Supply Chain, and Device Services. Data is a key strategic asset for running Microsoft Devices Operations. If you are looking for the opportunity to build highly scalable services and rich data insights on Azure, then MDO is the right place for you to come and take on your next challenge. We are seeking a skilled Data Engineer II to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate should have a solid background in data engineering, a passion for working with large datasets, and a drive to help our organization make data-driven decisions. You will be responsible for building, maintaining, and optimizing data pipelines and systems, ensuring data quality and availability, and supporting our data analytics, AI and ML initiatives. Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond. Responsibilities As a Data Engineer in MDO, you will drive critical initiatives to help our data platform scale to the needs of business priorities and technology advancements. Build scalable data models and data pipelines to extract, load and transform data, ensure secure data storage, with focus on data quality and compliance on Azure using services (ADF, HDI, Databricks, Fabric/Synapse etc.). You will play a critical role in developing and building datasets and integrate with AI/ML and Co-Pilot applications. Collaborate with data scientists, analysts, and other stakeholders to understand data requirements and deliver solutions. Implement and manage CI/CD(YAML + Classic) pipelines for data engineering projects, leveraging tools like Azure DevOps. You will anticipate data governance needs, designing data modeling and handling procedures to ensure compliance with all applicable laws and policies. You’ll also govern data accessibility within your assigned pipelines. Acts as a Designated Responsible Individual (DRI) and guides other engineers by developing and following the playbook, working on call to monitor system/product/service for degradation, downtime, or interruptions, alerting stakeholders about status and initiates actions to restore system/product/service for simple and complex problems when appropriate. Qualifications Preferred Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field. OR Master's Degree in Computer Science, Math, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field. OR equivalent experience. Experience with building data pipelines and data stores. 6+ years of experience in data engineering or a similar role. Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, Scala. Solid experience with SQL and database technologies. Familiarity with big data technologies (e.g., Hadoop, Spark). Excellent communication and interpersonal skills are required. Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) is a plus. Experience in working and integrating with AI/Co-Pilot applications. #W+DJOBS #MDO This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled. Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance with religious accommodations and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application process, read more about requesting accommodations.

review_candidates.title: Senior AI Software Engineer - VOIS
review_candidates.description: Who We Are VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation. As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability. We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal. #VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture About This Role We are seeking an experienced Senior AI Software Engineer to design, develop and deploy advanced artificial intelligence solutions, intelligent agents, copilots and enterprise automation workflows. You will combine expertise in large language models, machine learning, retrieval-augmented generation, robotic process automation, application programming interfaces and cloud technologies to deliver secure, scalable and governed solutions aligned with business objectives. The role is based at SV VHub-2 and reports to the Data and Analytics Technical Lead What You’ll Do Translate senior stakeholder priorities into practical AI, machine learning and generative AI architecture, implementation roadmaps and measurable transformation outcomes. Lead the design and implementation of end-to-end automation across cloud, desktop, enterprise resource planning, legacy and enterprise applications using robotic process automation, reusable components, APIs and custom code. Develop and deploy intelligent agents, copilots and autonomous assistants using appropriate triggers, knowledge sources, integrated tools, escalation logic and governance controls. Embed large language models, machine learning, retrieval-augmented generation, document intelligence and content extraction into workflows to improve reasoning, data extraction and business process execution. Design and maintain orchestration pipelines covering prompt management, context handling, response validation and output quality controls. Manage the automation lifecycle across development, testing and production environments, including data loss prevention policies, source control, continuous integration and delivery, release management and operational monitoring. Collaborate with enterprise, application, data and DevOps architects, data scientists, machine learning operations specialists and business teams to assess use cases and define solution designs. Partner with product, engineering and compliance teams to deliver AI capabilities securely, responsibly and efficiently. Support technical review boards and design authority approval processes. Guide small delivery teams and support technical and citizen developers through mentoring, peer reviews and clear documentation Who You Are You hold a bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related discipline. You bring at least three years of professional experience in enterprise automation, robotic process automation, intelligent process automation, AI agent development or cloud-native workflow orchestration. You have at least two years of experience working with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud Platform. You have hands-on production experience with large language models, including prompt engineering, evaluation and orchestration using LangChain, LlamaIndex or equivalent technologies. You understand agentic system design, including multi-step reasoning, tool use, planning, autonomous execution and multi-agent collaboration.You have advanced Python development skills for AI orchestration, backend agent logic, retrieval-augmented generation and workflow automation, together with proficiency in C#/.NET or Java. You have experience with enterprise AI platforms such as Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Search or Google Vertex AI, as well as vector databases, embeddings, fine-tuning and evaluation methods. You can deploy and operate AI or automation workloads using Docker and cloud execution platforms such as Azure Container Apps or Azure Kubernetes Service. You understand enterprise integration patterns, including APIs, custom connectors, OAuth-secured services, enterprise applications and third-party data sources.You have experience with automation and delivery technologies such as UiPath, Power Automate, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps or GitLab CI.You can manage competing priorities and multiple projects effectively. You communicate clearly with clients and stakeholders and can translate complex technical concepts into accessible business language. You are familiar with Agile delivery methods, including experience working in Scaled Agile Framework environments. You can lead small teams, collaborate across disciplines and support effective project delivery. Not a perfect fit? Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best. What's In It For You The opportunity to deliver production-ready AI, agentic and intelligent automation solutions with measurable business impact. Exposure to multidisciplinary collaboration across AI, data science, architecture, engineering, DevOps, compliance and business teams. The opportunity to shape enterprise AI architecture, implementation roadmaps and responsible governance practices. Experience leading technically complex initiatives across cloud, automation and enterprise application environments. Opportunities to mentor technical and citizen developers while contributing to peer reviews and engineering standards What Skills You Will Learn Advanced design and orchestration of enterprise AI agents and copilots. Production implementation of retrieval-augmented generation, prompt management and response-quality controls. Integration of AI services with enterprise platforms, secured APIs and legacy applications. Operation of resilient AI and automation workloads using containerisation, cloud platforms and continuous delivery pipelines. Responsible AI governance, monitoring, automated testing, root-cause analysis and self-healing automation. Cross-functional solution design and stakeholder engagement within a large enterprise environment. VOIS Equal Opportunity Employer Commitment Vodafone recognises and celebrates the value of diversity in building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities it serves. No form of discrimination is tolerated. This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination based on race, colour, age, veteran status, gender, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, political affiliation, trade union membership, nationality, citizenship, indigenous status, medical condition, HIV status, neurodiversity, social origin, cultural background, marital or civil partnership status, or socio-economic background. Join Us At Vodafone, we’re working hard to build a better future. A more connected, inclusive and sustainable world. As a dynamic global community, it's our human spirit, together with technology, that empowers us to achieve this. We challenge and innovate in order to connect people, businesses, and communities across the world. Delighting our customers and earning their loyalty drive us, and we experiment, learn fast and get it done, together. With us, you can truly be yourself and belong, share inspiration, embrace new opportunities, thrive, and make a real difference. review_candidates.title: Strong Middle Data Engineer
review_candidates.description: Strong Middle Data Engineer – Customer Platform & Data Position Overview We are seeking Strong Middle Data Engineers with solid experience in distributed data systems, Spark-based data processing, and production-grade data platform engineering. In this role, you will build, scale, maintain, and improve large-scale data platforms supporting critical initiatives across customer data, data pipeline expansion, compliance-related engineering, new data source integration, and platform modernization. The ideal candidate is a hands-on engineer who can work independently, take ownership of technical solutions, contribute to system design and implementation, and operate effectively in a highly automated development environment. The engineering organization is evolving toward a spec-led and agentic development model , where engineers increasingly focus on defining requirements, designing data models, creating technical specifications, reviewing AI-generated code, and ensuring overall solution quality. Key Responsibilities Develop, maintain, and optimize batch and streaming data pipelines using Scala and Apache Spark. Build and support Kafka-based data processing and streaming solutions . Create and maintain Apache Airflow DAGs , workflows, and data processing schedules. Design and implement data models, schemas, mappings, and validation checks. Develop scalable ETL/ELT pipelines using SQL and distributed data processing technologies. Monitor pipeline health, investigate failures, and troubleshoot production issues. Support deployments and ensure reliable operation of production data platforms. Implement data quality and validation controls to ensure accurate and reliable data. Review and validate AI-generated code and proposed implementations . Collaborate with senior engineers, product teams, and data consumers to deliver technical solutions. Contribute to system design, technical specifications, and modernization initiatives. Take ownership of assigned systems and components, including reliability, maintainability, and performance. Required Qualifications 3+ years of professional Data Engineering experience . Strong hands-on experience with Scala and Apache Spark . Experience working with batch processing and distributed data systems . Practical experience with Kafka, Kafka Streams, Flink , or similar streaming technologies. Hands-on experience with Apache Airflow , including DAG development and workflow management. Strong knowledge of SQL, data modeling, and ETL/ELT development . Experience with software engineering practices including: Automated testing Code reviews Git/version control CI/CD Production deployments Strong troubleshooting and production support capabilities. Ability to work independently and take ownership of technical solutions. Good communication and collaboration skills. Ability to understand technical requirements and translate them into reliable data engineering solutions. Nice-to-Have Qualifications Hands-on Apache Flink experience. Experience with Cassandra, DynamoDB, ScyllaDB , or other NoSQL databases. Experience working with customer data, clickstream, loyalty, booking, or transactional data . Experience with GitHub Copilot, Claude, Cursor , or other AI-assisted development tools. Understanding of data quality monitoring, observability, and pipeline health monitoring . Experience with specification-driven or spec-to-code development . Familiarity with agentic development frameworks and engineering practices. Success Profile The successful candidate is a strong middle-level Data Engineer who can work with limited supervision while knowing when to involve senior engineers. You should be able to demonstrate: Practical experience building and maintaining Spark-based data pipelines . Solid Scala development experience in production. Understanding of distributed data processing and batch workloads. Hands-on experience with Kafka or comparable streaming technologies . Ability to build and manage Airflow DAGs and production workflows . Strong SQL, ETL/ELT, and data modeling skills. Ability to troubleshoot pipeline failures and production data issues. Experience participating in code reviews, testing, CI/CD, and deployments. Ability to review AI-generated code critically and identify incorrect, inefficient, or unsafe implementations. An ownership mindset toward data quality, reliability, maintainability, and delivery. Ability to communicate effectively with senior engineers, product teams, and data consumers. Engineering Environment You will work in a modern, highly automated data engineering environment using technologies including: Scala | Apache Spark | Kafka | Kafka Streams | Apache Flink | Apache Airflow | SQL | NoSQL | CI/CD | AI-Assisted Development The team is moving toward a spec-led, agentic engineering model , giving engineers greater responsibility for requirements definition, technical specifications, data modeling, solution design, and validation of AI-assisted implementations. Why This Position? Work on large-scale data platforms supporting high-priority business initiatives. Gain exposure to complex customer, transactional, compliance, and operational data. Work with modern distributed data technologies including Spark, Scala, Kafka, and Airflow . Participate in the modernization and expansion of enterprise data platforms. Develop skills in AI-assisted and agentic software development . Collaborate closely with experienced senior engineers while owning meaningful technical components. Work in an engineering culture focused on automation, quality, reliability, and continuous improvement.
